people.imagined: Weighing a buy-out price, tapping an abacus bead once before he speaks, no malice but no mercy.
people.subject: The moment: at a table in a quiet hall, he taps one bead of an abacus once with his forefinger and looks at the viewer evenly, giving a disciple the price of a buy-out without any heat, no malice and no mercy. Face: a neat, dry, pale face with level grey eyes, thin straight brows, thin lips, neat ears and a trim line of moustache above a small mouth. Hair: black, in a tidy topknot held by a slender jade pin with a small silver goose finial. Body: thin, upright and still, his back straight. Clothing: three crossed collars of layered silk, the inner one rust, the middle dusk-violet, the outer a long robe of dusk-violet brocade with a sunset-gold gauze over-robe falling in exact folds from wide sleeves; the collars are embroidered in gold thread with flying geese and sunset clouds, the cuffs folded to precisely the same width, and a rust silk sash is knotted exactly in the centre, hung with a grey-jade pendant and a small stern-lamp clasp. Hands and objects: the right forefinger rests on one polished black bead of a small abacus with brass wires on a lacquered table; beside it a perfect stack of narrow paper slips. Power: a thin, orderly shimmer of earth-gold motes settles evenly around his shoulders, each mote in its place. Background: a dim hall wall of pale stone in drifting mist, one box of brass weights on a shelf and a small bronze lamp at the table's far corner with a single steady spark. Light: cool silver spirit-light from the upper left with a faint violet rim on his sleeves and no warmth in it. Expression: calm and cold, a level gaze and a closed mouth, a temperate man who finds fairness in arithmetic and feels nothing about it.

people.imagined: Adding a caravan manifest in her head while her leg jiggles under every desk.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a desk in a bright counting hall, she grins quick and restless at the viewer, a caravan manifest adding itself in her head while the dusk practice bores her and her knee jiggles under the desk. Face: a bright, sharp, freckled face with quick dark eyes, high arched brows, a small nose and a wide grin showing small even teeth. Hair: black, in two tight buns tied with red silk cord and little gold bead tassels, one bun slipped lower than the other. Body: small, wiry and restless, her shoulders bobbing. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-gate silk: a pale ochre inner collar and a crossed ochre outer robe of soft layered silk with wide sleeves rolled unevenly, a single border of tiny gold flying geese along the collar, a bright red silk sash with a fine tassel and a small grey goose-feather pin at the chest. Hands and objects: one hand counts off numbers on its fingers in the air while a slim brush in the other taps the desk. Background: a softly glowing counting office, shelves of tally books with coloured tags dissolving into pale mist, a bronze weight on papers at the desk edge. Light: bright soft golden spirit-light from a window at upper left with a gentle warm rim along her cheek. Expression: impatient and ambitious, the smile coming and going like a flicker and the face never still, a clever girl who finishes every sum before the teacher finishes the question.

people.imagined: Copying contracts with grey sleeve cuffs, a quiet glance at the head's own hand on an old loan.
people.subject: The moment: at a copying desk in a tall archive, he glances up with a careful look, one finger resting on a page, having noticed the head's own hand in the register of an old loan and saying nothing. Face: a thin, pale, careful face with wide cautious dark eyes, pale lashes, thin brows, a thin nose, pale lips and a faint worry line between the brows. Hair: black, in a neat topknot held by a plain black lacquer pin, the ears sticking out a little. Body: thin, narrow and stooped, his neck bent forward. Clothing: layered inner-gate silk in rust, an outer robe of rust with a crossed dusk-violet collar neatly pinned and wide sleeves that fall in long folds, the borders embroidered in gold thread with sunset clouds, the cuffs shiny grey with ink at the edge; a bone clasp holds the silk sash. Hands and objects: a fine brush in the right hand; the left forefinger rests on a sheet of neat rows of small marks, no characters; the register lies open to the loan, its page full of neat marks. Power: a few pale grey-gold motes drift over the page. Background: tall shelves of scrolls fading into blue-grey mist, a faint glow behind them. Light: cool silver spirit-light from a high window falling on the page and his hands, a soft rim on his hair. Expression: careful, honest and cautious, the face trying to stay blank and failing, a small crease of alarm showing between the brows.

people.imagined: Walking in with the wide careful steps of a man used to low roofs, ducking at every door.
people.subject: The moment: stepping through a low black door, he ducks his head just in time and looks up at the viewer stubbornly and kindly, walking with the wide careful steps of a man used to low roofs. Face: a square, broad, brown face with steady dark eyes, thick brows, a flat nose, a generous wide mouth, a scar across the brow and a small white scar on the chin. Hair: black, chopped short, a little dusty. Body: broad and thick-set, stooping slightly, with very wide shoulders. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-gate silk, a pale ochre robe in two crossed collars with sleeves tied back for work, stretched across his shoulders, the hem dusty at the knees where he kneels in galleries and edged with a narrow gold border of flying geese; a plain ochre sash with a small grey-jade pendant, and sturdy dark cloth boots. Hands and objects: a rolled bundle tied on his back with a rope, a small iron hammer sticking out of it; one broad, scarred hand raised to guard his head from the lintel. Power: faint silver-grey motes cling to his knuckles. Background: the black doorway in mist and a pale glowing yard beyond with a few drifting motes. Light: soft silver spirit-light from the upper left falling through the doorway behind him, a gentle rim along his shoulder. Expression: a kindly, stubborn, amiable look, the mouth wide and the brows level, a brave man who will carry your load without being asked.

people.imagined: On the archery line, a bow at full draw, a hand's width behind a better shot and sure it is the name.
people.subject: The moment: on the archery line at dusk, he lowers the bow slightly from full draw and glares sideways at the viewer, a shot having missed the centre by a hand's width and him sure the better shot has taken his name. Face: a lean, hard, brown face with a long jaw, a broad forehead, sharp dark eyes, strong brows, a flat nose and a thin set mouth. Hair: black, in a high knot with a silver pin and a dark ribbon, strands sticking to his sweating neck. Body: lean, muscular and upright with corded arms. Clothing: layered inner-gate silk, a rust robe with a crossed dusk-violet collar open at the throat and a thin dusk-violet band on the hem, the wide sleeves tied back with silk cord, gold geese embroidered along the collar, a slim leather arm guard and a dark quiver at the hip; a rust sash with a stern-lamp clasp. Hands and objects: chapped fisherman's hands hold a long bow with polished horn tips and an arrow with grey fletching. Power: sharp grey-brown wisps of qi curl off his drawn string. Background: a long line of straw targets fading into violet dusk mist, a few pale motes rising. Light: low gold spirit-light from the upper left, a hard cool rim on his jaw and shoulder. Expression: resentful and proud, the mouth a hard thin line and the eyes bright with a sense of injury, an ambitious archer who cannot forgive being second.

people.imagined: A goose pin and a ferry toll token swinging together on one cord, wanting the tolls back before she forms her foundation.
people.subject: The moment: standing straight in the cold dusk, she lifts a cord bearing a grey goose pin and a ferry toll token and looks coldly at the viewer, remembering the night a toll clerk lost two fingers to the frost and wanting the tolls back before she forms her foundation. Face: a sharp, hard, pale face with high cheekbones, narrow cold eyes, thin straight brows, a straight nose and a thin tight mouth. Hair: black, in a tight high braid pinned with a silver comb. Body: lean, tall and taut, one hand behind her back. Clothing: layered silk in rust with a crossed dusk-violet collar buttoned to the throat, narrow wide-cut sleeves falling straight, gold sunset-cloud embroidery on the cuffs and a black silk belt with a dark jade ring. Hands and objects: on one cord at her chest a small grey goose-feather pin in a silver clasp and a square-holed copper toll token swing side by side, clearly visible. Power: a cold grey-brown mist of qi lies close about her shoulders, thin and disciplined. Background: a wide drill field of pale earth fading into mist, a rank of cadets in rust robes small and still, a rack of spears at the edge. Light: hard pale moonlit glow from high on the left, a sharp rim along her cheekbone. Expression: a cold, proud, warlike stare, the lips thin and the chin high, loyal to a grudge she has kept for years and has not once let go.

people.imagined: Sweeping the drying floor of the Maple Hall, a plain kindly face that people forget as soon as she leaves.
people.subject: The moment: holding a long straw broom on the drying floor of the Maple Hall, she smiles shyly at the viewer, worrying that her Earth will not rise twelve points, a plain kindly face that people forget as soon as she leaves. Face: a very plain, round, kind face, wide and mild, with rosy cheeks, low faint brows, small mild brown eyes, a short easily forgotten nose and a small smile. Hair: brown, in a plain bun held by two long brown wood pins, some hairs clinging to her cheeks. Body: sturdy and ordinary, her shoulders slumped, her feet set a little pigeon-toed on the swept boards, her back with the slight curve of someone who sweeps for hours. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-gate silk, a perfectly clean pale ochre robe in two crossed collars with a thin gold border of flying geese, the wide sleeves tied back with a soft cord, and a plain ochre sash with a small pressed red maple leaf pin. Hands and objects: both work-roughened hands on a long broom of pale straw tied with a green string; a drift of red maple leaves lies at her feet. Power: a faint green-gold glimmer of motes rises from the leaves around her. Background: a hall of drying trays of leaves in rows, soft amber haze and drifting mist. Light: soft golden spirit-light from the left, a warm rim on her round cheek. Expression: shy, humble and kind, worried but trying to look cheerful, the smile held a little too still.

people.imagined: Squatting like a rice-planter even indoors, content, waiting to be placed where there are fields.
people.subject: The moment: squatting low on his heels beside a doorway, he grins easily at the viewer as if in a field, content to be placed wherever there are fields, his weight nearly on his heels as if the floor were a paddy bank. Face: a round, sun-brown, peaceful face with kind small eyes, thick brows, big ears, a short nose, a cheerful chin and a wide easy smile. Hair: black, cropped short, a little straw dust in it. Body: stocky, low and relaxed, knees wide, thick forearms resting on his knees and broad bare feet planted flat. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-gate silk, a clean pale ochre robe with crossed collars and wide sleeves rolled to the elbow, the hem tied up, cuffs muddy with grey clay, a border of small gold geese at the collar and an ochre sash with a small jade bead. Hands and objects: both hands hold a loose bunch of bright green rice seedlings with white roots tied with wet string. Power: a few warm yellow-brown motes float up from the seedlings. Background: a glowing doorway, a pale hall floor and a flooded paddy beyond shimmering with sky and mist. Light: soft spirit-light pouring through the door, laying a bright rectangle on the floor and a rim of gold on his cheek. Expression: a content, peaceable, diligent smile, the face relaxed and the eyes half closed with pleasure, a farm boy who knows exactly where he belongs.

people.imagined: Singing the fourth verse on a boat, her long thin throat ringing like a bell.
people.subject: The moment: on the bow of a boat at dusk, she throws her head back and sings the fourth verse as it climbs and the boat rocks, her long throat showing, then glances at the viewer. Face (most important: a very long thin neck, plainly visible): a thin, bright, tanned face with narrow bright eyes, arched brows, a long nose, a pointed chin, a wide mouth open in song and a ring of tiny freckles around the nose. Hair: black, in a long braid tied with blue silk thread, hanging forward over one shoulder, a small silver pin at the crown. Body: slender and long-necked, with a narrow chest. Clothing: layered inner-gate silk, a short close-fitting rust robe with crossed collars and an open dusk-violet outer collar closed by a small brass stern-lamp clasp, gold sunset-cloud embroidery at the borders and wide sleeves tied back with red cord so they trail like ribbons. Hands and objects: one hand cups her throat as if to feel the note; the other holds a wet brown rope. Power: faint blue-grey ripples of qi shimmer in the air around her mouth, following the note. Background: a river at dusk melting into violet mist, a stern lamp glowing. Light: warm gold glow of the stern lamp lighting her chin and long throat, a pale blue rim on her braid. Expression: bold and a little vain of her voice, the eyes sliding sideways to see who is listening, a sociable singer who changes her song to suit the crowd.

people.imagined: Humming with her mouth closed as her grandmother does, trying to find the verse the village stopped singing.
people.subject: The moment: with her mouth closed and her brows lifted, she hums and looks gently at the viewer, humming her grandmother's line as she tries to find the verse the village stopped singing. Face: a round, soft, honest face with light brown skin, round cheeks, a small flat nose, trusting dark eyes half closed in the hum and closed smiling lips. Hair: black, in two short braids tied with green silk thread that bob when she hums. Body: small, plump and gentle, her shoulders relaxed, swaying very slightly with the tune, her round chin tilted up. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-gate silk, a clean pale ochre robe with crossed collars and soft wide sleeves, a thin gold border of flying geese, a green silk sash and a small brass stern-lamp clasp pinned at the collar. Hands and objects: one hand held to her throat, fingers resting on it to feel the hum; the other holds a corner of her sash. Power: faint blue-grey motes drift slowly in time with her humming. Background: a quiet choir hall of wooden benches fading into blue mist. Light: soft silver spirit-light from a window at the left, lighting her round cheek with a gentle glow. Expression: a dreamy, trusting gentleness, a little smile curving the closed lips and the brows lifted in listening, an honest girl who believes the lost verse can still be found.

people.imagined: Copying sea charts by lamplight, ink on both ears, thinking of the third boat.
people.subject: The moment: at a lamp-lit table in a ship's cabin, he looks up from copying sea charts with ink-smeared ears and an eager stare, the third boat about to sail and him wanting a place on it. Face: a young, bold, thin face with a long nose, bright dark eyes, thin brows, a keen mouth and ink smears on both ears, a cheek and the jaw. Hair: black, in a messy knot tied with a bit of blue silk string, with ink in it too. Body: lean and restless, leaning forward with his elbows on the table. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-gate silk, a pale ochre robe with crossed collars and wide sleeves rolled to the elbow, the cuffs inked, a trace of sea salt on the cloth, a thin gold border of flying geese, and a cord at his neck holding a small brass compass. Hands and objects: a fine, nearly dry brush in his hand over a chart covered with tiny stars and a coastline, no writing. Power: a few pale blue-green motes of qi drift up from the wet ink. Background: a dark cabin glowing with sea mist, a lamp swinging on a chain. Light: warm yellow lamp glow from the left that swings slightly, with a pale blue moonlit rim on his hair. Expression: eager, hungry and impatient, a half grin as if he already stood on the deck, a brave, ambitious young man with ink on his face and the horizon in his eyes.

people.imagined: Bamboo-brown arms, trying not to smile because she may go to Nhàn Vân Quán.
people.subject: The moment: holding her lips together to hide a smile, she stands in a bamboo grove and looks at the viewer with bright eyes, hoping to be placed at Nhàn Vân Quán, her bamboo-brown forearms bare. Face: a calm, round, golden face with smooth cheeks, bright dark eyes, straight soft brows and the corners of the mouth tucked in hard to stop the smile. Hair: black, in a single braid tied with a green silk string and ending in a small knot, a tiny jade leaf pin above the ear. Body: slim and strong-armed, standing with her shoulders held a little too straight with the effort of staying still, her feet turned inward at the toes. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-gate silk, a clean pale ochre robe with crossed collars and wide sleeves pushed up to the elbow, a green silk sash, a bamboo-leaf pattern embroidered at the hem in pale thread and a thin gold border of flying geese at the collar. Hands and objects: the tanned forearms marked with the pale green juice of cut bamboo; she holds a bamboo cutting knife with a curved blade and a worn wooden handle. Power: soft green motes drift up around her like pollen. Background: tall green stalks of a bamboo grove dissolving in mist. Light: soft green-filtered spirit-light from above left, a gentle glow on her cheek. Expression: bright-eyed and almost trembling with the effort of not smiling, the lips pressed and the cheeks lifting anyway, humble and contained.

people.imagined: Drawing a miasma scar on his wrist with charcoal each morning, repeating his father's words.
people.subject: The moment: in a grey watch hall, he holds up his left wrist where a false scar is drawn in charcoal, looking fiercely at the viewer, drawing the miasma scar each morning like a ritual and repeating his father's words. Face: a young, hard, tanned, square face with keen dark eyes, heavy brows and a firm jaw with a small cleft in the chin. Hair: black, chopped short and standing up at the crown, held back by a plain dark ribbon. Body: lean and tense, standing with his chest out, back straight as a spear shaft, his free hand clenched in a fist as if on a hilt he has not been given. Clothing: layered inner-gate silk, a rust robe with a crossed dusk-violet collar belted tight, a short dove-grey silk jacket over it with a stitched dusk-violet edge, gold sunset-cloud embroidery at the cuffs and a stern-lamp clasp at the belt. Hands and objects: a short black charcoal stick in one hand; on the other wrist a jagged, neat charcoal-drawn scar, smudged at one end, clearly visible. Power: faint grey-gold motes sit still on his clenched fist. Background: a grey wall of the watch hall in drifting mist with a single hook. Light: pale cold moonlight from the left, a thin silver rim on his jaw. Expression: solemn and fierce, the jaw clenched and the gaze level, as if rehearsing his father's lines to a crowd that is not there, a brave and loyal young man who wants a wound he has not earned.

people.imagined: Squatting at the miasma's edge placing stones to mark where the grey moved in the night.
people.subject: The moment: squatting to read the ground at the edge of the grey miasma, she looks up at the viewer with a careful calm, the grey having moved again in the night and her placing another stone to mark it. Face: a lean, shore-brown face with a long jaw, thin cheeks, patient grey-brown eyes, straight brows and a small tight quiet mouth. Hair: black, in a tight bun under a pale grey silk scarf with a few strands escaping. Body: lean and crouched, heels down, knees apart and forearms on her thighs, perfectly balanced. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-gate silk, a clean pale ochre robe with crossed collars and wide sleeves tied back, a soft dove-grey gauze vest over it, a thin gold border of flying geese at the collar and an ochre sash. Hands and objects: one hand sets a smooth round grey stone on the ground at the end of a line of stones that recedes behind her into the mist; a small iron lantern near her knee with a pale glow. Power: a ghostly grey-green haze creeps along the ground toward her and thins where she has placed her stones. Background: a plain of ash fading into pale mist with no horizon, dead reeds standing stiff. Light: pale grey-green spirit-light from the left with a cold rim on her scarf. Expression: patient, cautious and unhurried, the eyes steady and the mouth quiet, a solitary woman reading the ground as if it were a page.

people.imagined: Counting lamps with knotted cords at her belt, a granddaughter beside the Owl, now counting the gaps.
people.subject: The moment: at night on a shore, she runs a knotted cord through her fingers and looks at the viewer with wary eyes, a granddaughter of the Owl, counting the gaps in the line of lamps where one is missing. Face: a thin, pale, serious face with hollow cheeks, small wide dark eyes, a pointed chin and thin brows drawn together over a tight mouth. Hair: black, in a tight braid tied with a knotted cord of black thread. Body: slim and alert, standing very still with her weight on one foot and her head slightly bowed, narrow shoulders held tight. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-gate silk, a clean pale ochre robe with crossed collars under a dove-grey gauze sea cloak knotted at the neck with a cord, a row of tiny knots stitched along the collar and a narrow gold border of geese at the hem. Hands and objects: a loop of knotted cords hangs at the belt like a fringe and one runs through her fingers, the knots in fives, clearly visible. Power: pale blue-grey motes gather around each knot and fade. Background: black night water with a far line of small glowing lamps and tiny points of reflection, mist low on the water. Light: cold silver moonlight from above left, a faint blue rim on her cheek and cloak. Expression: wary and worried, the lips pressed together and the eyes moving along the line, a diligent, honest girl who suspects that every missing lamp is a message.

people.imagined: At the armoury bellows, singed eyelashes, sworn to secrecy about a sword's hum.
people.subject: The moment: at the armoury bellows, she pumps with a bright grin and looks at the viewer, her eyelashes singed, sworn to secrecy about a sword's hum and pumping harder to keep it. Face (most important: singed short eyelashes, curled where the fire has taken them): a freckled, bright, sooty round face with big bold eyes, a snub nose and a wide grin. Hair: black, in a messy tail tied with a red silk ribbon, the tips of the tufts singed. Body: small and wiry, with thin strong arms. Clothing: a servant's plainer but clean silk, a pale ochre tunic of soft cloth with crossed collars and the wide sleeves bound to the shoulder with red cord, a scorched hem and a narrow ochre sash; no apron, only a small grey goose-feather pin at the collar. Hands and objects: both hands on the long bellows handle, dark wood worn smooth, sweat running on her forearms. Power: sparks and embers of orange-red qi drift upward past her face and hover like fireflies, and from somewhere in the racks a faint silver hum of light trembles. Background: a forge cavern of rust-red brick glowing in smoke and mist, racks of long blades half in shadow, coals heaped in a stone hearth and an anvil black against the fire. Light: orange coal glow from the lower left, throwing a bright rim on her cheek and arm. Expression: merry and bold, a friendly grin with a secret kept firmly behind it, the face of a brave, sociable girl who has never once told what she heard.

people.imagined: Rowing on the evening water with her grandfather's slow level stare.
people.subject: The moment: at the oars of a small boat on evening water, she gives the viewer a slow level stare with her grandfather's eyes, having promised the second oar on the keeper's last row. Face: a calm, brown, round face with long lashes, pale water-grey-green eyes, straight brows and a closed steady mouth. Hair: black, in a long plait tied with grey silk string and hanging over one shoulder, a small bone pin at the crown. Body: strong and steady, sitting upright at the oars with a straight back and long steady arms. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-gate silk, a clean pale ochre robe with crossed collars and wide sleeves tied up, the skirt tucked at the knee, a thin cape of pale gauze pinned with a bone pin, a narrow gold border of flying geese at the collar. Hands and objects: both brown, firm hands on two oars blackened with age. Power: pale blue-green ripples of qi run from the oar blades across the water, soft and slow. Background: a calm sheet of copper and pale pink water under a low sky, a small green isle dark on the horizon and a single heron motionless on a post near the shore, all softened in mist. Light: soft red-gold sunset glow from the left, with ripples of light on the water and a gentle rim on her cheek. Expression: steady and unhurried, the pale eyes level and the mouth closed, a compassionate, stubborn girl who has already decided to keep her promise.

people.imagined: Blushing at praise; his palms held the glow to full dark at the first try.
people.subject: The moment: standing with his eyes lowered at dusk on the steppe, he blushes and glances at the viewer, the examiner having told him not to boast; he holds his palms out a little way as though he does not quite trust them, the glow flickering on them like a candle in a draught, while behind him a river child watches with open envy. Face: a plain, kind, round face with red-flushed cheeks and reddening ears, shy dark eyes, thick straight brows and an embarrassed half-smile. Hair: black, short and flat on one side. Body: stocky and solid, shoulders drawn in, heels together. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-gate silk, a clean new pale ochre robe in two crossed collars with wide sleeves, a thin gold border of flying geese at the collar and a plain brown silk sash with a small jade bead. Hands and objects: both palms held shyly out, glowing yellow-brown, as if apologising. Power: a steady, surprisingly full glow of earth-gold light rests on his hands with a few golden motes rising, brighter than a first try should be. Background: a wide steppe of yellow grass fading into violet dusk mist, a few tents small in the distance and a young river child watching from the edge of the frame. Light: warm low dusk light from the left, with the glow of his palms lighting his chin from below. Expression: shy and humble, the lips pressed together to hide a pleased smile and the eyes unable to meet the viewer's for more than a moment, a calm boy startled by his own gift.

people.imagined: Practising in the noon sun with a pink forehead to prove the examiner is unfair.
people.subject: The moment: under the noon sun on a bare steppe, she practises a stance and glares at the viewer, her forehead sunburnt, the sun high and the examiner unfair, and she practising still. Face (most important: a bright pink sunburnt forehead): a thin, fierce face with narrow dark eyes that burn, heavy straight brows, thin cheeks, a peeling nose and a set mouth with the lips pressed white. Hair: black, in a tight high tail tied with a red silk cord and wet at the ends. Body: wiry and lean, knees bent in a low stance, feet wide and shoulders square. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-gate silk, a clean pale ochre robe with crossed collars, the wide sleeves tied above the elbow, the collar soaked and clinging to her neck, with a thin gold border of flying geese and a red sash. Hands and objects: her fists tight with white knuckles, sweat dripping from her chin and running down the pink forehead into an eyebrow. Power: a small, hot orange-brown shimmer of qi trembles around her fists, flaring and failing. Background: a bare steppe under a hot white sky blurring into haze, a single dry thorn tree far off, its shadow a tiny dot. Light: hard white noon spirit-light from above left, almost no shadow, with a rim of fire-orange along her shoulder. Expression: a steady, resentful glare, the jaw clenched and the eyes unblinking, an ambitious, diligent girl whose whole face says she will prove the examiner wrong.

people.imagined: Hopeful smile, maple sap on his cuffs, a bucket tipping over somewhere near him.
people.subject: The moment: in a maple grove, holding a wooden sap bucket, he smiles hopefully at the viewer as the bucket tips and a branch drops behind him, the roster having lost his name again. Face: a round, open, sun-brown face with wide brown eyes, raised thick brows, a weak chin and a nervous hopeful smile. Hair: brown, a tangle with a red maple leaf stuck in it. Body: tall and lanky, swaying a little as though ready to catch something that falls. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-gate silk, a pale ochre robe with crossed collars and wide sleeves, amber sap stains on both cuffs and a larger stain on the front, a thin gold border of flying geese at the collar, an ochre sash and a pressed red maple leaf pinned at the chest. Hands and objects: a wooden sap bucket with an iron band tipping in his hand, amber sap dripping on his wrist; behind him a branch has just fallen. Power: soft green-gold motes of wood qi swirl up from the spilled sap and cling to the leaves. Background: maples in full red and amber standing in rows in warm mist, drifts of fallen leaves, a second bucket hanging from a trunk and a thin tin spout shining in the bark. Light: warm gold spirit-light slanting through the maples from the left, a golden rim on his hair and shoulder. Expression: a hopeful, cautious, unlucky smile, the eyes wide and the brows raised in advance apology, a humble young man who expects the next small disaster and meets it politely.

people.imagined: A dice cup rattles in his sleeve as he asks a favour with a smile.
people.subject: The moment: in a lantern-lit alley, leaning one shoulder on a post with one foot crossed over the other, he shakes a small dice cup in one hand and grins slyly at the viewer, having just asked a favour while the dice rattle in his sleeve. Face: a sly, handsome, narrow face with quick dark eyes, thin arched brows and a lopsided grin. Hair: black, in a loose knot tied with a red silk cord, strands hanging at his ears. Body: slim and loose-limbed, lounging. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-gate silk, a rumpled but clean pale ochre robe with crossed collars and wide sleeves hanging half open, a thin gold border of flying geese at the collar, a gaudy yellow silk sash tied in a showy bow and a dice-string tassel hanging from his belt beside a small jade pendant. Hands and objects: a small bamboo dice cup with a leather band in the right hand, two bone dice showing a pair of sixes; a bright coin in the left. Power: a few faint brown-green motes flicker around the dice as if the luck is leaning his way. Background: a narrow alley of stalls glowing with strings of paper lanterns in red and yellow, the blurred shapes of passers-by and a fruit seller in mist at the far end. Light: warm lantern glow from the left, red and gold, rimming his cheek and sleeve. Expression: a sly, stubborn, greedy grin, one brow cocked and the eyes bright with calculation, the easy charm of a young man who never asks without a plan to collect.

people.imagined: Red dust on her sandals, holding the glow easily, rather be digging a well.
people.subject: The moment: standing with a spade on the steppe, she gives the viewer a plain cheerful look, having stopped to wipe her forehead with the back of her wrist and left a red streak of clay there; she would rather be digging a well. Face: a round, wholesome, tanned face with honest bright straight dark eyes, thick brows, a snub nose, a round chin and a wide open smile. Hair: black, in a short braid tied with a bit of ochre silk and hanging down her back. Body: sturdy and strong-armed, standing square with broad shoulders. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-gate silk, a clean pale ochre robe with crossed collars and wide sleeves tied back, the skirt tied up at the knee and the hem and cloth shoes stained red by clay dust, a thin gold border of flying geese at the collar. Hands and objects: both hands on the handle of a well-digger's spade whose dull blade is caked with red clay. Power: a gentle brown-gold glow of earth qi rests on the spade and the clay, as if the ground were glad of her. Background: a pale gold steppe rolling away in mist under a wide clear sky, a half-dug well-shaft with a plank frame and a bucket on a rope, a pile of red clay with a second spade stuck in it and a few distant sheep as specks. Light: bright soft spirit-light from above left, warm on her face, with a golden rim along her arm. Expression: a broad, easy, unbothered grin, brave and content, a girl glad to be outdoors with a spade in her hands.

people.imagined: Half asleep with straw in his hair during dusk practice, eyelids at half-mast.
people.subject: The moment: in a dusk yard, sitting up from a doze, he blinks drowsily at the viewer, the dusk practice going on a few paces off while he has slid down against a post with his chin on his chest, a cow's bell hanging on a cord from his belt as a memory of the herds of Ngưu Đẩu. Face: a round, sleepy, tanned face with half-lowered lids, thick brows, a soft chin, a lazy smile and a little dribble of drool. Hair: brown, with several straws stuck in it, clearly visible. Body: big and soft, slumped against the post with his legs stretched out. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-gate silk, a pale ochre robe with crossed collars, creased from sleeping and hanging open at the neck, with wide rumpled sleeves and a thin gold border of flying geese. Hands and objects: one hand rubs an eye while the other props up his chin. Power: faint brown motes drift lazily around him like dust in a sunbeam. Background: a dusk yard with a splintered hitching post, a bucket and a long low roof edge, and behind him a row of figures kneeling in the half-dark in mist, their palms glowing faintly, the sky pale orange above them. Light: warm low gold spirit-light from the left, a soft rim along his cheek. Expression: a lazy, trusting, good-natured half-smile with the eyes at half mast, a boy with no idea that he is being looked at.

people.imagined: Rolling his sleeves to the same fold, witnessing a seal, asked a polite question about oaths.
people.subject: The moment: in a plain hall, rolling a sleeve to a precise fold, he looks at the viewer with an earnest cautious look, having been asked which oath broke first, and setting a stamp on a sheet beside him. Face: a neat, young, pale face with careful grey eyes, straight brows and thin precise lips. Hair: black, in a tidy topknot fastened straight with a bone pin. Body: slim and neat, standing exactly straight with his shoulders level and his chin tucked. Clothing: layered inner-gate silk, a rust robe with a flat clean crossed dusk-violet collar and wide sleeves, the cuffs folded to exactly the same width of two fingers, a thin gold embroidery of flying geese along the collar and a rust sash with a small grey-jade pendant and a stern-lamp clasp. Hands and objects: both hands set a small dark wooden stamp with a round face on a sheet of paper, the corner pinned under his forefinger. Power: a faint level shimmer of grey-gold motes hangs over the stamp as the ink sets. Background: a pale plastered hall in drifting mist, a single dark wooden bench, a low table with a brass lamp and a folded cloth, a bare hook on the wall. Light: cool silver spirit-light from the left, a thin clean rim on his sleeve. Expression: careful, honest and cautious, the eyes level and the lips thin, the look of a just young man who dislikes answering questions he cannot check.

people.imagined: Holding one palm flat as if weighing the air, testing a note by its weight.
people.subject: The moment: in a market office, holding her palm flat and level in front of her, she studies the viewer as if weighing them, a thin paper note resting on her palm and weighing light. Face: a sharp, pale, narrow face with narrowed calculating eyes, thin brows, a thin nose and a thin line of mouth. Hair: black, in a sleek low knot held by a black lacquer pin with a tiny gold bead. Body: slim and poised, standing very upright with one hand held out flat and perfectly steady. Clothing: layered inner-gate silk, a crisp rust robe with a crossed dusk-violet collar and wide sleeves falling in sharp folds, gold geese and sunset clouds embroidered along the borders, a pale ochre silk sash knotted exactly and a tiny brass scale pinned at the collar. Hands and objects: the right palm held out flat with the note on it, its edge faintly curling; the other hand hovers above it. Power: a few brown-gold motes hover at her palm and the note trembles at their weight. Background: shelves of lacquered boxes in rust and ochre climbing into mist, each with a small brass lock, and the corner of a heavy counting table with an abacus at the frame edge. Light: cool silver spirit-light from the left with a thin gold rim on her cheek and sleeve. Expression: wary and greedy, the narrowed eyes weighing and the mouth set, a diligent woman who does not trust any value she has not held in her own hand.

people.imagined: Carrying a lamp in the galleries with a limp from a cave-in, lamp-soot in the corners of her eyes.
people.subject: The moment: in a dark gallery, she raises a lamp and limps a step toward the viewer, a limp from a cave-in, looking toward the locked door with a fresh scuff of dust on its sill. Face (most important: lamp-soot in the corners of both eyes): a brave, plain face with trusting dark eyes, thick brows and a firm mouth, a smear of soot at each eye corner. Hair: black, in a messy knot tied with a silk cord, dusty, a silver pin askew. Body: small and wiry, favouring her left leg. Clothing: layered inner-gate silk, a rust robe with a crossed dusk-violet collar, dusty, the hem scuffed pale by the gallery floor, wide sleeves tied back, gold sunset-cloud embroidery dulled by dust at the borders. Hands and objects: one hand holds up a battered tin lamp with a steady yellow flame; the other leans on a short silver-pine prop. Power: silver-grey motes of qi cling in a faint ring to her prop and to the lamp's flame. Background: a dark timbered gallery narrowing between rough stone walls in drifting dust and mist, a heavy iron-bound door at the end of the lamp's reach and the roof above sagging with shadow. Light: warm yellow lamp glow from below lighting her face under the chin, a silver rim on her shoulder. Expression: determined and a little frightened, the eyes wide and the mouth firm, a brave, trusting woman walking toward a door she was told to avoid.

people.imagined: Standing very still like someone who has heard everything, holding a kettle, thin tea in the caddy.
people.subject: The moment: in a small tea room, standing very still with a kettle in both hands, she gazes calmly at the viewer, topping the caddy with spent leaves, a woman who has heard everything and will say none of it. Face: a pale, lined, still face with thin lashes, patient dark unblinking eyes that give nothing, thin brows and a tiny closed mouth. Hair: grey-white, in a tight low bun pinned with a plain wood pin. Body: small, thin and upright, motionless, her elbows tucked in. Clothing: a servant's plain but clean silk, an old rust robe of soft crossed layers, spotless and faded, with narrow sleeves and a white silk apron-sash tied over it, only one thin line of pale gold embroidery at the collar. Hands and objects: both hands hold an old black iron tea kettle with a bent handle and a chip in the spout; a wooden tea caddy on the table beside her. Power: none; only steam rising from the spout in a soft curl with a faint glow in it. Background: a small tea room of dim wood, a low table with a bamboo mat, a shelf of mismatched cups and a window with a pale paper blind glowing softly through mist. Light: soft silver glow from the paper window at the left, a gentle rim on her white hair. Expression: patient and unreadable, nothing showing on her face, the stillness of a loyal old servant who keeps other people's secrets by never reacting to them.

people.imagined: Serving at a guest's elbow with a forgettable face and a tray held exactly right.
people.subject: The moment: in a guest room over a gorge, holding a tray exactly at the height of the viewer's elbow, she smiles forgettably, having set it beside a rope-buyer so softly he did not notice, and she will repeat every word he says, adding a line of her own to please. Face: a forgettable, even, pleasant face with soft brown eyes, level brows and a small smile. Hair: black, in a plain bun tied with a brown silk cord. Body: slim, quiet and neat, standing lightly. Clothing: a servant's plain but clean silk, a spotless rust tunic with crossed collars and sleeves tied back with a plain cord, a white silk apron-sash and a narrow line of gold geese at the collar. Hands and objects: both hands hold a tray with a white china teapot with a blue ring and two small plain cups. Power: a very faint brown-green shimmer clings about her ears, as if the room's words settled there. Background: a window opening over a mist-filled gorge, a polished dark-wood floor reflecting the pale glow and the empty guest cushion beside the table set with a folded napkin. Light: a soft silver glow from a paper window lighting her pale cheek, a gentle rim on her bun. Expression: a pleasant look that never changes, the smile fixed and only the quick attentive eyes showing that she is listening to everything.

people.imagined: Oiling a maple stump in the autumn, smelling of maple oil, sitting later in the kitchen.
people.subject: The moment: in an old courtyard in autumn, kneeling by a cut maple stump with an oil cloth, he looks up peacefully at the viewer, having oiled this stump every autumn since he was a boy and humming a tune without words as the rings darken under his cloth. Face: a sunken, weathered, brown, peaceful face with hollow cheeks, faded kind eyes, sparse brows and a toothless smile. Hair: thin grey, tied in a wisp with a bit of silk twine. Body: bent and thin, kneeling slowly with one hand on the stump to steady himself. Clothing: a servant's plain but clean silk, a faded pale ochre robe in soft crossed layers, long worn smooth and smelling of maple oil, with a thin pale-gold line of embroidery at the collar and a plain cord belt. Hands and objects: one hand holds a folded cloth shining with oil on the stump's pale rings, which are dark and glossy. Power: soft green-gold motes of wood qi rise slowly from the oiled rings, the stump seeming to breathe. Background: pale flagstones strewn with red maple leaves, a low plastered wall and a kitchen door open on a warm dark interior, all in gentle mist. Light: low gold autumn spirit-light from the left lighting the oil on the stump like honey, with a warm rim on his white hair. Expression: a peace so complete that the toothless smile seems to come from the wood itself, devout, patient and content.

people.imagined: A dawn-red ribbon in her braid, announcing she will not be sold, choosing bench-mates from a hat of names.
people.subject: The moment: in an outer-gate yard, with her chin high, she lifts a small cloth hat of folded paper slips and smiles boldly at the viewer, announcing she will not be sold, having marked the names in the hat for choosing bench-mates. Face: a bold, pretty, round face with bright dark eyes, arched brows, a small nose, a confident wide smile and a small mole at the corner of the mouth. Hair: black, in a thick braid tied with a bright dawn-red silk ribbon, clearly visible, with a small gold hairpin. Body: sturdy and confident, standing with her chin lifted and her feet apart. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-gate silk, a clean pale ochre robe with crossed collars and wide sleeves, a thin gold border of flying geese, a rust silk sash tied in a firm bow and a dawn-red ribbon at the chest matching the one in her braid. Hands and objects: one hand holds a brown cloth hat full of folded slips, shaking it a little; the other on her hip. Power: a few bright brown-gold motes dance above the hat as the slips shuffle. Background: a pale earth yard in morning mist, a long bench beside a brick stove, other girls in ochre robes watching from the bench and a thin plume of stove smoke rising. Light: bright soft golden spirit-light from the left, a dawn-red glow on her ribbon and a rim on her cheek. Expression: a bold, ambitious, arbitrary smile, the chin up and the eyes sparkling, a girl who intends to choose her own company and enjoys the power of the draw.

people.imagined: A rope burn across his left palm that has never closed, offering to go back into the grey.
people.subject: The moment: at the edge of an ash plain, holding up his left palm to show a raw rope burn, he looks steadily at the viewer, the rope having gone slack in his hand that day and him still feeling it, offering to go back into the grey. Face (most important: a red unhealed rope burn across the left palm): a young, pale, wary face with shadowed eyes, thick brows drawn together and a set mouth. Hair: black, short and rough, bound by a plain grey ribbon. Body: lean and taut, narrow, with his shoulders raised and his feet planted. Clothing: the simplest graceful outer-gate silk, a clean pale ochre robe with crossed collars, the cuffs creased by the rope, a dove-grey silk scarf wrapped twice around the neck and a thin gold border of flying geese at the collar. Hands and objects: the left palm raised with the raw red burn across it, clearly visible; a coil of coarse brown rope with an unravelled end on the other shoulder. Power: faint blue-grey motes cling to the burn like frost and drift away. Background: a grey mist thickening into a wall at the edge of the ash plain, a few black stakes leaning in the haze and a pale trail of footprints leading out of the frame toward it. Light: pale cold moonlit glow from the left, a thin silver rim on his scarf and jaw. Expression: wary, loyal and brave, the mouth set and the eyes shadowed, a young man ready to walk back into the grey because he cannot forgive the rope.
